intention: Every account stores the first day the app analyzes vehicle data, and the external-charges page rejects charges dated before it.
request: MAG-55 — restrict adding external charges for dates before the account's analysis start date; persist that date in a new column and suggest where it belongs.

decisions.what: analysis_start_date DATE NOT NULL lives on account.settings, not on accounts or vehicles.
decisions.why: settings is already the one-row-per-account typed table (RM42 D3). Per-vehicle is more correct once a second car exists, but costs teslaID plumbing today.

decisions.what: The rule is enforced in internal/gateway only. internal/charging is not touched.
decisions.why: Trades domain-level safety for one fewer module and wave. Accepted consequence: a non-gateway caller of charging.Writer can still save a bad date.

decisions.what: The rule compares Entry.ChargedOn only, never StartedAt.
decisions.why: ChargedOn is required on every entry and is what analytics uses. StartedAt is optional and unused there.

decisions.what: The date is read-only. No settings form field, no write port method.
decisions.why: Keeps the ticket small. Editing is deferred to backlog item 27 with its own trigger.

decisions.what: No unit tests in this roadmap.
decisions.why: The owner's standing default. Build, vet and the guards still run.

budget.note: Two worker waves, one leader cross-module fix, one stale-test fix, one review round.
